parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM podcasts_sources WHERE youtube_url = '{{ $json.youtube_url }}'

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'already_processed', message: 'URL déjà traitée, aucune action effectuée.', youtube_url: $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.youtube_url }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ short_id: $json.short_id, youtube_url: $json.youtube_url, video_path: $json.video_path, audio_path: $json.audio_path, transcript_path: $json.transcript_path }) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO podcasts_sources (youtube_url, title, duration_s, r2_video_path, r2_transcript_path, status) VALUES ('{{ $json.youtube_url }}', '{{ $json.title.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', {{ $json.duration_s }}, '{{ $json.r2_video_path }}', '{{ $json.r2_transcript_path }}', 'transcribed') ON CONFLICT (youtube_url) DO UPDATE SET status = 'transcribed', updated_at = NOW() RETURNING id

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, text: '✅ Transcription OK : ' + $('HTTP: Download + Audio').item.json.title + ' (' + Math.floor($(\'HTTP: Download + Audio\').item.json.duration_s / 60) + 'min)', parse_mode: 'HTML' }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', short_id: $('HTTP: Download + Audio').item.json.short_id, title: $('HTTP: Download + Audio').item.json.title, duration_s: $('HTTP: Download + Audio').item.json.duration_s, r2_video_url: $('HTTP: Upload R2').item.json.r2_video_url, r2_transcript_url: $('HTTP: Upload R2').item.json.r2_transcript_url }) }}
